engineering_checks.scope: Configuration-only local fixture; no Docker, solver, task verifier, provider, or benchmark was executed.
Re-run after the completed new intent and after relocating build-only dependencies to .venv. This pre-existing failure remains visible; no protected test or historical intent was changed.
engineering_checks.baseline_evidence: The intent exists as Git blob 38ae76a073882d21bc1c3c15d4ecfbef39b55e36 at the base, and that referenced path is absent from the base tree. Neither the old intent nor the protected test was changed.

observed_regressions: The host open_model sentinel was never called; the sole dispatch is quoted environment.exec with instruction bytes carried in a request file, not shell interpolation.

Uncertain execution, malformed receipts, failed request upload/download, mismatched source/request/patch identities and false self-verification never become successful publications or a replayed solve.
Private-index patches replay through real git apply, including binary, new, deleted, symlink, executable, staged and already committed changes, without modifying the original index.
Dirty tracked or nonignored untracked initial workspaces are refused rather than attributing image changes to the solver.
Real isolated child processes observed EPERM for IPv4, IPv6 and Unix sockets, including a descendant; setsid/setpgid were also refused, while local file writes remained possible.
A real process test exposed asynchronous SIGKILL delivery after a leader exits. Child-subreaper adoption and reaping now finish before patch capture; both normal-exit and timeout regressions pass.
Worker symlink, hardlink, FIFO and oversized outputs are rejected; host publication replaces links without touching their targets.
Image toolchain variables are restored only after filtering. Provider keys, LD_PRELOAD and PYTHONPATH are not admissible tool environment entries.

Existing on-disk primary/snapshot registry receipt paths were checked against a staged export: 98 of 98 and 88 of 88 were present, respectively. This is not a complete dynamic-dependency qualification.

Pre-filter interpreter, module and bytecode paths must be root-owned, outside the writable task workspace, and non-replaceable by the worker. Root preparation refuses hardlinked workspace files instead of changing ownership outside the tree.

environment_setup_issue.initial_guard_scan: Downloaded CPython sources/stdlib tests and Harbor dependencies were initially placed under .benchmarks, which the unchanged integrity guard does not skip. The scan hit its tool timeout; its completed log listed 513 violations, all in those third-party dependency trees, none in project sources. The concurrent broader pytest run was stopped after timeout.
environment_setup_issue.remedy: Move build-only Python/dependency trees to the repository-standard .venv exclusion, preserving interpreter paths through ignored symlinks. No project source/test, guard, policy, fixture or historical answer was substituted or excluded. Re-run the unchanged guard and tests on the live tree.
